scope: Nalthis base site records and six event slots; scene IDs inventoried, scene claims not certified

baseSites.name: T’Telir
baseSites.desc: Hallandren’s capital, built in a crescent around a sheltered bay on the Bright Sea, with markets, merchant mansions, slums and docks, and Awakened statues everywhere.

baseSites.name: The Court of Gods
baseSites.desc: A walled plateau in the south of T’Telir over the sea: a ring of palaces for the Returned and the God King’s black palace, where Siri is sent to be married.

baseSites.name: D’Denir garden
baseSites.desc: A quiet field of hundreds of old warrior statues in the north of the city.

baseSites.name: The Bright Sea
baseSites.desc: The landlocked sea east of Hallandren, which Idrians call the Inner Sea.

baseSites.name: Endowment’s perpendicularity
baseSites.desc: In a shadowy jungle cavern in Hallandren; its seeping Investiture feeds the Tears of Edgli flowers. Worldhoppers pass customs here. The exact site is not given.

baseSites.name: Bevalis
baseSites.desc: The small capital of Idris in a mountain valley, Siri and Vivenna’s home.

baseSites.name: The Idrian passes
baseSites.desc: Idris controls four trade passes north through its mountains and lives on their tolls.

baseSites.name: Pahn Kahl
baseSites.desc: A quiet southern province of tropical lowlands inside Hallandren, with grievances of its own.

baseSites.name: Tedradel
baseSites.desc: The kingdom directly across the Bright Sea, friendly with Idris and at odds with Hallandren since the Manywar.

baseSites.name: Kuth and Huth
baseSites.desc: Northern kingdoms beyond the Idrian mountains, destroyed in the Manywar.

record.title: Siri’s marriage
record.text: Idris sends its youngest princess to marry the God King of Hallandren, and she finds him nothing like the stories.

record.title: Vivenna in the city
record.text: Her sister comes after her, falls in with mercenaries and learns what the city really is.

record.title: Lightsong’s last day
record.text: A god who doesn’t believe in himself uncovers the plot to start a war and gives his Breath to heal the God King.

record.title: Vasher and Nightblood
record.text: A grim Awakener with a talking black sword works to stop the war he helped cause long ago.

record.title: Siri’s marriage
record.text: Siri of Idris arrives at the Court of Gods to marry the God King of Hallandren.

record.title: Vivenna in the city
record.text: Her sister comes after her, falls in with mercenaries and learns what the city really is.

record.title: Lightsong’s last day
record.text: In captivity, Lightsong gives his Breath to heal Susebron, sacrificing himself to restore the God King’s tongue.

record.title: Vasher and Nightblood
record.text: Vasher and Nightblood work to prevent a new war between Hallandren and Idris; Vasher’s past is tied to the earlier Manywar.

record.title: The Lifeless march
record.text: After killing Blushweaver and threatening Llarimar, the plotters obtain Lightsong’s command phrase, change it, and order the Lifeless to march on Idris.

record.title: Susebron speaks
record.text: Susebron uses Awakened cloth to rescue Siri. Vasher entrusts him with the D’Denir army, which is sent after the Lifeless marching on Idris.

after.ttelir: Hallandren’s capital curves around a bay on the Bright Sea, with painted buildings and warrior statues at street corners.
after.denir: A quiet grassy field in T’Telir, filled with hundreds of weathered warrior statues.
